MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
Reported regime: NEUTRAL, with normal volatility at 27.2% and weak breadth: 0/8 sectors positive over one week. Participation is broadly negative despite volatility remaining below the high-volatility threshold.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Construction & REIT led on a relative basis, though still down 2.76% for the week; ALARK (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +5.51%) is in CORRECTION. Energy & Chemicals was next, down 3.96%; GUBRF (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -0.63%) and PETKM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -12.29%) are in RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom was weakest at -10.05% for the week, followed by Retail & Food at -7.50%. TTKOM (1W: -8.28% | 1M: -4.93%) and MGROS (1W: -10.97% | 1M: -4.40%) are both BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
GUBRF (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -0.63%) and PETKM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -12.29%) are in RECOVERY; ALARK (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +5.51%) is in CORRECTION. HEKTS (1W: -0.63% | 1M: -1.87%) and TKFEN (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -3.14%) are BELOW TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: -14.87% | 1M: +50.66%) and VESTL (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +4.43%) are in CORRECTION. TRMET (1W: -12.32% | 1M: -5.56%), MGROS (1W: -10.97% | 1M: -4.40%) and AKBNK (1W: -9.27% | 1M: -5.68%) are BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The strongest weekly moves came from GUBRF (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -0.63%) and PETKM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -12.29%), both in RECOVERY. Next-best relative performers were ALARK (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +5.51%) in CORRECTION and HEKTS (1W: -0.63% | 1M: -1.87%) BELOW TREND.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance fell 7.22% for the week; breadth is poor, with the sector also down 1.81% over one month. AKBNK (1W: -9.27% | 1M: -5.68%) and YKBNK (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -5.26%) are BELOW TREND, while GARAN (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +10.05%) is in CORRECTION.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry declined 5.39% for the week and 3.12% over one month. TOASO (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +5.75%) is in CORRECTION, while EREGL (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -5.98%) and FROTO (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -1.34%) are BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
The sector fell 3.96% for the week and 5.35% over one month; GUBRF (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -0.63%) and PETKM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -12.29%) show short-term RECOVERY. TUPRS (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -10.58%) remains BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay defensive, preserve liquidity and avoid broad exposure until market breadth improves; no sector passed the supplied two-week quant screen. Treat short-term rebounds selectively and maintain tight risk limits given the across-the-board weekly declines.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Monitor GUBRF (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -0.63%) and PETKM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -12.29%) for follow-through in RECOVERY. Also watch TOASO (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +5.75%), PGSUS (1W: -3.32% | 1M: +24.00%) and GARAN (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +10.05%), all in CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Track Construction & REIT and Energy & Chemicals for signs that their relative resilience can turn into positive weekly performance. Banking & Finance also warrants close attention after its 7.22% weekly decline.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 price levels were supplied, so specific support or resistance levels cannot be stated. Key triggers are a recovery in sector breadth from 0/8 and a sustained move back into positive weekly returns.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The reported regime is NEUTRAL, but 0/8 positive sectors and broad weekly losses point to weak participation. Relative opportunities are concentrated in selective recovery names, while the lack of positive sector breadth and weak quant rankings argue for a cautious, liquidity-focused stance.
